meanings.meaningEn: to give up
forsake, leave behind

example: Abandon the study.
translation: 연구를 중단하세요.

meanings.meaningEn: capability, talent
the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment

example: The notice announces that the club coaches will offer ability groups and weekly recovery checks.
translation: 공지에는 클럽 코치들이 능력별 그룹과 주간 회복 점검을 제공할 것이라고 발표합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: capable of doing something

example: Riders must be able to reach stations safely, transfer reliably, and complete the final part of a trip.
translation: 승객은 안전하게 역에 도착하고, 신뢰성 있게 환승하며, 여행의 마지막 단계를 완료할 수 있어야 합니다.

meaningEn: in or to a foreign country

meanings.meaningEn: in or to a foreign country
far away from home or one's usual surroundings
in a place across an ocean

example: Many students choose to study abroad for a semester.
translation: 많은 학생이 한 학기 동안 해외에서 공부하는 것을 선택합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: not present
nonexistent
lost in thought; showing preoccupation

example: Theo: We should also account for the possibility that small employers may struggle to cover absent staff.
translation: 테오: 소규모 고용주는 자리를 비운 직원을 대신할 인력을 마련하기 어려울 수도 있다는 점도 고려해야 합니다.

meaningEn: to take in or soak up

meanings.meaningEn: to take in or soak up
become imbued
take up mentally

example: Porous materials can absorb fats left on the surface.
translation: 다공성 물질은 표면에 남은 지방을 흡수할 수 있습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: plentiful

example: Student: I noticed that solar energy is abundant at noon but demand peaks later.
translation: 학생: 저는 태양 에너지가 낮에 풍부하지만 수요가 나중에 급증한다는 것을 알게 되었습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: scholarly; relating to education
hypothetical or theoretical and not expected to produce an immediate or practical result
marked by a narrow focus on or display of learning especially its trivial aspects

example: Maya: The available evidence suggests that regular mentor contact improved use of academic support services.
translation: 마야: 현재까지의 증거는 정기적인 멘토와의 교류가 학업 지원 서비스 이용에 도움이 된다고 시사합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to accept, adopt
receive willingly something given or offered
consider or hold as true

example: The speaker explicitly cautions that users still accepted terms when services offered no alternative.
translation: 발표자는 사용자들이 서비스가 다른 대안을 제공하지 않을 때에도 조건을 수락한다는 점을 명확히 경고합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: satisfactory or permissible
worthy of acceptance or satisfactory
judged to be in conformity with approved usage

example: The acceptable trade-off depends on purpose: a website photograph and a medical image have different preservation needs.
translation: 수용 가능한 절충은 목적에 따라 다릅니다. 웹사이트 사진과 의료 이미지는 서로 다른 보존 요구 사항을 가지고 있습니다.

meaningEn: the act or state of being accepted

meanings.meaningEn: the act or state of being accepted

example: Draft papers do not satisfy the acceptance requirement.
translation: 초안 논문은 승인 요건을 충족하지 않습니다.

meaningEn: the ability or right to enter or use

meanings.meaningEn: the ability or right to enter or use
the right to enter
the right to obtain or make use of or take advantage of something (as services or membership)

example: For step-free access, enter through the science building and use elevators to the connecting bridge.
translation: 무장애 접근을 위해 과학 건물 입구에서 엘리베이터를 이용하여 연결 다리로 이동하십시오.

meanings.meaningEn: the quality of being accessible
the quality of being at hand when needed
the attribute of being easy to meet or deal with

example: Walk-in service is reserved for students with accessibility needs or physician referrals.
translation: 예약 없이 이용하는 서비스는 접근성 지원이 필요하거나 의사의 의뢰를 받은 학생을 위해 마련되어 있습니다.

meaningEn: able to be reached or used

meanings.meaningEn: able to be reached or used
capable of being read with comprehension
easily obtained

example: A campus health workshop has useful information, but its registration page is not accessible with a screen reader.
translation: 캠퍼스 건강 워크숍에는 유용한 정보가 있지만, 스크린 리더로 접근할 수 있는 등록 페이지가 없습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: an unintended or chance occurrence

example: appear by accident
translation: 우연히 발생

meaningEn: in a way appropriate to the circumstances

meanings.meaningEn: in a way appropriate to the circumstances
(sentence connectors) because of the reason given
in accordance with

example: Effective campaigns identify these different causes and respond accordingly.
translation: 효과적인 캠페인은 이러한 다양한 원인을 파악하고 적절하게 대응합니다.

meaningEn: to consider, to take into account

meanings.meaningEn: to consider, to take into account
to give an account or representation of in words
be the sole or primary factor in the existence, acquisition, supply, or disposal of something

example: Theo: We should also account for the possibility that individual systems give households more control.
translation: 테오: 또한 개별 시스템이 가정에 더 많은 통제권을 줄 가능성도 고려해야 합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to gather, to pile up
get or gather together
increase in amount by collecting or gathering

example: The student opens the conversation by noting that dry vegetation has accumulated near several homes.
translation: 학생은 건조한 식물이 여러 가정 근처에 쌓여 있다는 사실을 언급하며 대화를 시작합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: relating to sound

example: The notice announces that the library administration will separate acoustic zones and improve room reservation signs.
translation: 공지에는 도서관 행정부가 음향 구역을 분리하고, 방 예약 표지를 개선할 것이라고 발표합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to obtain, gain
come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
gain through experience

example: Professor Hall: Should museums invest more in broad access or in acquiring new objects?
translation: 홀 교수: 박물관은 폭넓은 접근성에 더 투자해야 할까요, 아니면 새로운 유물을 확보하는 데 더 투자해야 할까요?

meanings.meaningEn: action; deed
something done (usually as opposed to something said)

example: Warning systems are most eff___ when messages explain concrete actions.
translation: 경고 시스템은 구체적인 행동을 설명하는 메시지가 있을 때 가장 효과적입니다.

meanings.meaningEn: energetically, vigorously

example: Professor Evans: Should cities manage urban wildlife actively or allow ecosystems to adjust on their own?
translation: 에번스 교수: 도시는 도시 야생동물을 적극적으로 관리해야 할까요, 아니면 생태계가 스스로 적응하도록 두어야 할까요?

meanings.meaningEn: activity
any specific behavior

example: Explain the effect on you, refer to the proposed plan to create weekly activity groups led by fluent speakers, and ask one specific question about timing or access.
translation: 자신에게 미치는 영향을 설명하고, 유창한 화자가 이끄는 주간 활동 모임을 만들겠다는 계획을 언급한 뒤, 시간이나 이용 방법에 관해 구체적인 질문 하나를 하세요.

meaningEn: real rather than planned or expected

meanings.meaningEn: real rather than planned or expected
taking place in reality; not pretended or imitated
presently existing in fact and not merely potential or possible

example: Student: I noticed that the app shows scheduled rather than actual arrival times.
translation: 학생: 앱이 실제 도착 시간 대신 예정된 시간을 보여주는 것을 확인했습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to adjust
make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose

example: Describe an example of wildlife adapting to a human environment.
translation: 인간 환경에 적응하는 야생 동물의 예시를 설명하십시오.

meanings.meaningEn: adjustment to new conditions
a written work (as a novel) that has been recast in a new form

example: This does not make a language less auth___; it shows adaptation.
translation: 이것이 그 언어를 덜 진정한 언어로 만드는 것은 아니며, 오히려 적응을 보여 줍니다. (문장 완성)

meanings.meaningEn: to add

example: Community notice: Because appointments fill before many students can request help, the counseling center will add evening sessions and a confidential online intake.
translation: 지역 공지: 많은 학생이 도움을 요청하기도 전에 예약이 마감되므로 상담 센터는 저녁 상담 시간과 비공개 온라인 접수 절차를 추가할 예정입니다.

meanings.meaningEn: supplement, addition
a component that is added to something to improve it

example: Responsible projects distinguish measured data from hypothetical additions and allow users to inspect alternative reconstructions when experts disagree.
translation: 책임감 있는 프로젝트는 측정된 데이터를 가설적인 추가 사항과 분리하고, 전문가 간의 의견 불일치 시 대체 재구성을 검사할 수 있도록 합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: extra; added

example: Theo: We should also account for the possibility that small organizations may need additional time and support.
translation: 테오: 작은 조직이 추가적인 시간과 지원이 필요할 수 있다는 점도 고려해야 합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to deal with
speak to

example: Health messages often fail when they provide facts without addressing the reason people hesitate.
translation: 건강 관련 메시지는 종종 사람들이 망설이는 이유를 다루지 않고 사실만을 제시할 때 실패합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to regulate/modify

example: Professor Evans: Should cities manage urban wildlife actively or allow ecosystems to adjust on their own?
translation: 에번스 교수: 도시는 도시 야생동물을 적극적으로 관리해야 할까요, 아니면 생태계가 스스로 적응하도록 두어야 할까요?

meanings.meaningEn: modification
making or becoming suitable; adjusting to circumstances
the act of making something different (as e.g. the size of a garment)

example: Explain how noise affects the activity and request a brief schedule adjustment or an alternative site.
translation: 소음이 활동에 미치는 영향을 설명하고, 일시적인 일정 조정 또는 대체 장소를 요청하십시오.

meanings.meaningEn: management, governance
the persons (or committees or departments etc.) who make up a body for the purpose of administering something

example: Community notice: Because group discussion spreads into areas intended for silent study, the library administration will separate acoustic zones and improve room reservation signs.
translation: 지역 공지: 조별 토론 소리가 조용히 공부하도록 마련된 구역까지 퍼지므로 도서관 운영진은 음향 구역을 분리하고 방 예약 안내 표지를 개선할 예정입니다.

meanings.meaningEn: relating to administration

example: In a labor economics center, researchers conducted a systematic assessment of automation in routine administrative work.
translation: 노동 경제 연구 센터에서, 연구자들은 일상적인 행정 업무에서의 자동화에 대한 체계적인 평가를 수행했습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: manager/administrator
the party appointed by a probate court to distribute the estate of someone who dies without a will or without naming an executor

example: Administrator: Text reminders helped, but some students still cannot come during class hours.
translation: 관리자: 문자 알림은 도움이 되었지만, 일부 학생은 여전히 수업 시간 중에는 올 수 없습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to allow, accept
declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of
allow to enter; grant entry to

example: They admitted diffuse light without intense afternoon heat.
translation: 그들은 강렬한 오후 햇빛 없이도 자연광을 활용했습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to adopt
take up and practice as one's own
take on titles, offices, duties, responsibilities

example: The notice announces that the field director will adopt a shared naming system and verify coordinates daily.
translation: 현장 감독은 공유 명명 체계를 도입하고 매일 좌표를 확인할 것입니다.

meaningEn: the act of beginning to use or accept something

meanings.meaningEn: the act of beginning to use or accept something
the act of accepting with approval; favorable reception

example: Why was adoption expensive?
translation: 도입 비용이 많이 든 이유는 무엇인가요?

meanings.meaningEn: grown-up
a fully developed person from maturity onward
any mature animal

example: Preliminary evidence indicated that children learned more words when adults asked open questions during play.
translation: 초기 연구 결과에 따르면, 어른들이 놀이 중에 열린 질문을 할 때 아이들이 더 많은 단어를 배우는 것으로 나타났습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: in advance, beforehand

example: Explain the conflict, ask whether another session is available, and request the emergency materials in advance.
translation: 갈등에 대해 설명하고, 추가 세션이 가능한지 문의하고, 미리 비상 물품을 요청하세요.

meanings.meaningEn: benefit, merit
the quality of having a superior or more favorable position

example: What is an advantage of returning samples?
translation: 샘플을 돌려보내는 것의 장점은 무엇인가요?

meanings.meaningEn: to advertise
call attention to

example: A campus food event advertised local products, but several labels did not identify where items came from.
translation: 캠퍼스 음식 행사는 지역 제품을 홍보했지만, 여러 제품의 출처를 명확히 표시하지 않았습니다.

meaningEn: the activity or material used to advertise

meanings.meaningEn: the activity or material used to advertise
a public promotion of some product or service

example: Student: I noticed that advertising presents an experimental therapy as if it were proven.
translation: 학생: 저는 광고가 실험적인 치료를 증명된 것처럼 제시한다는 것을 알았습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: guidance or recommendations
a proposal for an appropriate course of action

example: Professor Hall: Should mentors provide direct advice or mainly help students make their own decisions?
translation: 홀 교수: 멘토는 직접 조언해야 할까요, 아니면 주로 학생이 스스로 결정하도록 도와야 할까요?

meanings.meaningEn: to give advice or guidance
give advice to

example: The notice announces that the advising center will match schedules and goals as well as academic interests.
translation: 공지에 따르면 상담 센터는 학업 관심사뿐 아니라 일정과 목표도 고려해 연결해 줄 예정입니다.

meanings.meaningEn: faculty advisor

example: It was my advisor who suggested that I read it first
translation: 제 지도교수가 제가 먼저 읽어야 한다고 제안했습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: relating to the air/flight
characterized by lightness and insubstantiality; as impalpable or intangible as air

example: The passage directly states that aerial models revealed subtle landscape patterns without disturbing the ground.
translation: 이 글은 드론을 사용하여 지상에 피해를 주지 않고 미세한 지형 패턴을 파악할 수 있다고 직접적으로 언급합니다.

meaningEn: to influence or produce a change in

meanings.meaningEn: to influence or produce a change in
have an effect upon
act physically on; have an effect upon

example: A new system may affect employees' roles if it is introduced without preparation.
translation: 새 시스템을 준비 없이 도입하면 직원들의 역할에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: influenced/affected
speaking or behaving in an artificial way to make an impression
being excited or provoked to the expression of an emotion

example: You are affected because many street trees are the same age and vulnerable to one disease.
translation: 여러 나무들이 같은 나이가 같고, 하나의 질병에 취약하기 때문에, 여러분은 영향을 받습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: at a reasonable price

example: Theo: We should also account for the possibility that data-supported services may remain affordable to more users.
translation: 테오: 데이터 기반 서비스가 더 많은 이용자에게 감당할 수 있는 가격으로 제공될 가능성도 고려해야 합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: of the afternoon

example: Afternoon field groups must return by two thirty.
translation: 오후 필드 그룹은 오후 2시 30분까지 돌아와야 합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: age; years
how long something has existed

example: In a social policy institute, researchers conducted a systematic assessment of age-friendly neighborhood design.
translation: 사회 정책 연구소에서 연구자들은 연령 친화적인 지역 디자인에 대한 체계적인 평가를 수행했습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: an organization
an administrative unit of government

example: The notice announces that the transit agency will connect live vehicle data and label uncertain predictions.
translation: 공지: 교통 당국은 실시간 차량 데이터를 연결하고 불확실한 예측을 표시할 것입니다.

meanings.meaningEn: relating to agriculture

example: In an agricultural biology station, researchers conducted a systematic assessment of flower strips beside crop fields.
translation: 농업 생물학 연구소에서 연구자들은 작물 밭 옆의 꽃 줄기를 체계적으로 평가했습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: air
the region above the ground
a slight wind (usually refreshing)

example: Tell me about improving air quality in a familiar place.
translation: 일상적인 장소에서 공기 질을 개선하는 방법에 대해 알려주세요.

meanings.meaningEn: airplane
a vehicle that can fly

example: Understanding fracture is crit___ in aircraft, bridges, and medical implants, where a small def___ could have ser___ consequences.
translation: 항공기, 교량, 의료용 임플란트 등에서 균열을 이해하는 것은 매우 중요합니다. 작은 균열도 심각한 결과를 초래할 수 있기 때문입니다.

meanings.meaningEn: warning; notification
condition of heightened watchfulness or preparation for action
a warning serves to make you more alert to danger

example: Maya: The available evidence suggests that specific warnings about the suspicious feature outperformed generic alerts.
translation: 마야: 이용 가능한 증거는 특정 경고가 일반적인 경고보다 의심스러운 특징에 대한 경고가 더 효과적이라고 시사합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to assign, to allot
distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose

example: Limited processing resources were allocated elsewhere.
translation: 제한된 처리 자원은 다른 곳에 할당되었습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: to permit
make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
let have

example: Preliminary evidence indicated that multi-year support allowed groups to plan education programs and retain staff.
translation: 초기 증거에 따르면, 장기적인 지원은 그룹이 교육 프로그램을 계획하고 인력을 유지하는 데 도움이 되었습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: without other people
without any others being included or involved
without anybody else or anything else

example: Do you create better alone or with others?
translation: 혼자서 더 좋은 결과를 얻을 수 있나요, 아니면 다른 사람들과 함께 해야 하나요?

meanings.meaningEn: already

example: The speaker explicitly cautions that the program attracted firms already likely to succeed.
translation: 발표자는 프로그램이 이미 성공 가능성이 높은 기업들을 유치했다는 점을 명확히 경고하고 있습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: another available choice or option

example: More effective tools ask learners to compare alternatives, justify revisions, and reflect on recurring mistakes.
translation: 더 효과적인 도구는 학습자가 대안을 비교하고, 수정 사항을 정당화하고, 반복되는 실수를 되돌아보도록 합니다.

meanings.meaningEn: of/made of aluminum

example: Student: These aluminum frames look undamaged.
translation: 학생: 이 알루미늄 프레임은 손상되지 않은 것처럼 보입니다.

meanings.meaningEn: at all times
at all times; all the time and on every occasion
without variation or change, in every case

example: What evidence would help you decide this question: Should publicly funded research data always be openly available?
translation: 공공 자금으로 연구 데이터를 항상 공개해야 하는지에 대한 질문에 답하는 데 도움이 될 증거는 무엇입니까?

meanings.meaningEn: to amplify
to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
exaggerate or make bigger

example: Large ships can amplify waves near a narrow shoreline.
translation: 대형 선박은 좁은 해안 근처에서 파도를 증폭시킬 수 있습니다.

meanings.meaningEn: analysis, examination
an investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole
